name: Question 1
problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/multivariable/14070210/assets/2f847a5551c0bdc5aea20673814ba6eddc10daca7661cca2b2db76c953672225.png)

A plate occupies the region $D$ enclosed by the $y$-axis and the lines $x=y-1$ and $x=7-y$, as shown above. The mass density function of the plate is $\lambda (x,y)=\frac{y-1}{9}.$ Find the moment of inertia of the plate about the line $x=3.$
worked_solution:
The moment of inertia of a plane lamina in the shape of a region $D$ about an axis of rotation $l$ is given by

$$
{I}_{l}={∬}_{D}\lambda (x,y)[r(x,y)]^{2}\,\text{d}A,
$$

where $\lambda (x,y)$ is the mass density function of the lamina, and $r(x,y)$ is the distance from the line $l$ to the point $(x,y)$ on $D.$

First, notice that $D$ is a type I region with representation

$$
D={(x,y)\,:\,0\le x\le 3,\,\,x+1\le y\le 7-x},
$$

as shown below.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/multivariable/14070210/assets/b86b9a595786e544159e08fef12952c88e1bf9f796fb4ae3089e877dc9119b3f.png)

The distance between a point on $D$ and the line $x=3$ is given by

$$
r(x,y)=|x-3|
$$

Therefore, the moment of inertia about the line $x=3$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}I & ={∬}_{D}\lambda (x,y)[r(x,y)]^{2}\,\text{d}A \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{3}{\int }_{x+1}^{7-x}(\frac{y-1}{9})|x-3{|}^{2}\,\text{d}y\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{3}{\int }_{x+1}^{7-x}(\frac{y-1}{9})(x-3)^{2}\,\text{d}y\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{3}(x-3)^{2}[{\int }_{x+1}^{7-x}\frac{y-1}{9}\,\text{d}y]\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{3}(x-3)^{2}{[\frac{(y-1)^{2}}{18}]}_{x+1}^{7-x}\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{3}(x-3)^{2}[\frac{(6-x)^{2}}{18}-\frac{{x}^{2}}{18}]\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{3}(x-3)^{2}[\frac{12(3-x)}{18}]\text{d}x \\  & =-\frac{2}{3}{\int }_{0}^{3}(x-3)^{3}\text{d}x \\  & =-\frac{2}{3}{[\frac{(x-3)^{4}}{4}]}_{0}^{3} \\  & =-\frac{2}{3}(0-\frac{81}{4}) \\  & =\frac{27}{2}.\end{aligned}
$$

EXPLANATION

The moment of inertia of a plane lamina in the shape of a region D about an axis of rotation l is given by

Il=∬Dλ(x,y)[r(x,y)]2dA,

where λ(x,y) is the mass density function of the lamina, and r(x,y) is the distance from the line l to the point (x,y) on D.

First, notice that D is a type I region with representation

D={(x,y):0≤x≤3,x+1≤y≤7−x},

as shown below.

The distance between a point on D and the line x=3 is given by

r(x,y)=|x−3|

Therefore, the moment of inertia about the line x=3 is

I=∬Dλ(x,y)[r(x,y)]2dA=∫03∫x+17−x(y−19)|x−3|2dydx=∫03∫x+17−x(y−19)(x−3)2dydx=∫03(x−3)2[∫x+17−xy−19dy]dx=∫03(x−3)2[(y−1)218]x+17−xdx=∫03(x−3)2[(6−x)218−x218]dx=∫03(x−3)2[12(3−x)18]dx=−23∫03(x−3)3dx=−23[(x−3)44]03=−23(0−814)=272.
